title: Exhaustion Ceiling on Tailwise Pharmacy Customer Renewal Orders
content:
For a Tailwise Pharmacy renewal order on a prescription whose class requires a DEA-registered prescriber, the days' supply per fill the renewal asks for is no more than the exhaustion ceiling. The exhaustion ceiling looks at how early the renewed prescription ran out of fills: the calendar days from its closing date to its expiry date, as the prescription record shows them.

## Ceiling

| Renewed prescription | Calendar days from its closing date to its expiry date | Exhaustion ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| refills exhausted | 30 or more | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| refills exhausted | fewer than 30 | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 7 days, never more than the class maximum |
| expired | | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |

## Boundary (hypothetical dates; renewed prescription written for 21 days, class maximum 30 days)

| Status | Closing date | Expiry date | Days | Exhaustion ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| refills exhausted | 2026-05-01 | 2026-05-31 | 30 | 30 days |
| refills exhausted | 2026-05-02 | 2026-05-31 | 29 | 21 plus 7: 28 days |
| expired | 2026-05-31 | 2026-05-31 | | 21 days |
